_note: Eval briefs written by the Project 3 manager (design briefs, not facts). Each brief is run against all three SAMPLE envelopes.

briefs.text: About 120 units, ground-floor retail, a public courtyard, and step the building down toward the park to the north.
Mixed-use: roughly 60,000 sf of housing above about 8,000 sf of community facility (a library branch) on the lower two floors. Keep a strong, continuous street wall.
A slender residential building, around 200 units, with a two-story commercial base and generous roof terraces. Keep the open space at grade above 30%.
